result:
Cover images on posts are implemented, and every gate is green.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `bun run typecheck` | passes |
| `bun test` | 13 pass, 0 fail (11 new cover tests) |
| `bun run lint` | clean |
| `bunx guren check` / `audit` | 0 failures, no security findings |

**How it works.** The feature is built on Guren's own attachments layer rather than a hand-rolled upload table. Running `guren add attachments` installed the private `local` storage disk rooted at `storage/app` (`storage/app/testing` under tests), the `attachments` table, `config/attachments.ts`, an `AttachmentsProvider`, the signed delivery route mounted from `routes/web.ts`, and the prune command. The `Post` model is wrapped with `Attachable` and declares one `cover` collection, so attaching a new file replaces and purges the old row and file, and `purgeAttachments` runs on destroy. Both forms post multipart bodies; the controller reads the upload with `this.file('cover')`, and `app/Services/CoverUpload.ts` enforces PNG or JPEG by magic bytes and the 2 MB cap before anything is written, throwing a `ValidationException` on the `cover` key so the refusal matches an empty title exactly. `removeCover=1` on `PUT /posts/:id` detaches the cover. Every post resource now carries `coverUrl: string | null`, a signed URL served by the framework route with the original bytes and content type. The Index, Show, New and Edit pages render the cover, the file field, and the remove checkbox.

**Files changed.** New: `app/Services/CoverUpload.ts`, `app/Providers/AttachmentsProvider.ts`, `config/attachments.ts`, `config/storage.ts`, `app/Services/FileStorage.ts` (from the storage blueprint), `db/migrations/20260925052852_add_attachments/`, `.guren/attachments.gen.ts`, and `tests/PostCover.test.ts`, which covers PNG and JPEG uploads, GIF and oversized refusals with no rows or files left behind, replacement with old-URL 404 and old-file deletion, the keep-as-is edit path, removal, and deletion with the post. Modified: `app/Models/Post.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` and `HomeController.ts` (load covers via `withAttachments`), `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts` (`coverUrl`), `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` (`PostUpdatePayloadSchema` with `removeCover`), `routes/web.ts`, `db/schema.ts`, `src/app.ts`, `src/console.ts`, `config/env.ts` and `.env.example` (`STORAGE_DISK`), the four `resources/js/pages/posts/*.tsx` pages, `.gitignore` (`storage/`, `public/storage/`), and the regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` files.
